result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but the 'Popular right now' section has a stuck loading spinner overlaying an already-rendered restaurant image, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner centered over its hero image even though the image has clearly finished rendering behind it. The lingering overlay obscures the photo and suggests a broken image-load state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner on the image's onLoad/onError event, and ensure the loading state is cleared once the asset is cached or rendered.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first uses a white/transparent-outline heart with no visible container, while the second sits inside a dark filled circle.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent button treatment (same background chip, size, and icon color) to all favorite toggles across cards.

issues.description: The heart icon on the first card has very low contrast against the light noodle-bowl imagery, making the favorite control hard to see and tap-target unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-opaque circular backdrop or drop shadow behind the icon to guarantee contrast over any image, and provide an accessible label such as 'Add to favorites'.
